elaine: Heads-up — we're seeing a p99 jump (~120ms -> ~420ms) from the toronto POP starting ~10:58 UTC. Not correlated with deploys AFAIK. ops-bot: Alert: latency_anomaly detected on pop=toronto svc=runtime p99=420ms (baseline 115ms).elaine: Observed during replay that KV cache hit rate dropped ~30% and batch sizes collapsed to 1-2 per execution window. Likely cache warmup + request reordering/peering jitter. raj: I can repro on a probe instance, there are bursts of RTT spikes to the provider uplink (MPLS peer) causing request ordering to spread out. sam: Any kernel-selector flips or heuristic changes around that time? vlad: No recent kernel selector commits in prod. We did ship a small eBPF offload tweak earlier today to the edge NICs (infra change 2056778000). maria: infra change noted — rolling it back on a small ring now. elaine: Profiling snapshot attached (snippet): ```pprof text: total 50ms per request
- kv_lookup: 28ms (cache miss penalty)
- network_recv: 10ms (tail RTT)
- batching_gate: 8ms (timers/heuristic backoff)
- kernel_select: 4ms
```sam: The batching gate shows timers firing early because requests are delayed and then arrive in jittered bursts; our heuristic collapses batch windows to avoid latency, which backfires when KV cache isn't warm. raj: Peering jitter trace: ```
PING 10.0.0.1: time=2ms
PING 10.0.0.1: time=12ms
PING 10.0.0.1: time=180ms
PING 10.0.0.1: time=6ms
```elaine: Workaround: bump max_batch_window from 8ms -> 16ms for toronto pool to tolerate jitter, and enable soft-kv-prefetch to warm kv cache on probes. sam: Can we A/B this on 10% ring? maria: Doing canary now on toronto-az-a nodes. ops-bot: Deploy started: rollout_id=rdw-roll-2056789 target=toronto-az-a percent=10%elaine: Early canary looks good — p99 down to ~150ms and batch sizes stabilize ~6-8. raj: Filed ticket with carrier: TKT-3374 (peering flaps observed, attach traceroutes). vlad: We should also make batching heuristic jitter-aware: propose using EWMA of inter-arrival rather than instant window collapse. I'll open a PR for heuristic change and a perf test in staging. sam: Note: eBPF offload rollback didn't fully restore baseline for a subset of hosts — investigating NIC driver counters. maria: Provider acknowledged packet reordering on that ASN during our time window; they have an investigation ongoing. elaine: Postmortem action items: 1) temporary: keep toronto batch window at 16ms for 24h 2) infra: ensure eBPF offload rollout has canary metrics for RTT distribution 3) runtime: implement EWMA inter-arrival batching heuristic + kv-prefetch probe 4) ops: escalate with carrier and request BGP path stabilization. raj: I'll track carrier ticket and post updates. sam: I'll own the EWMA heuristic PR and perf bench. vlad: I'll add a regression test to catch cache-warmup regressions combined with jitter. maria: Rolling toronto full ring to 100% now as canary green. ops-bot: Rollout complete: rollout_id=rdw-roll-2056789 status=complete percent=100%elaine: Closing thread — will write short incident note once carrier confirms fix. :white_check_mark:
